spec.description: TV wall bracket: x points away from wall, y up, z across width. Four 12 mm diameter washer footprints on x=0 are fixed in x,y,z. Assume isotropic linear elastic steel E=210000 N/mm^2, nu=0.30; rigid wall/lag screw attachment. Preserve 6 mm thick washer pads and TV mounting plate (smallest whole 2 mm element thickness at least 5 mm). Apply total plate load (+50,-400,0) N uniformly over plate face. Volume fraction 0.15 applies to non-passive design volume; passive solids are excluded by tool convention.
